files.document_title: Enbridge coastal consistency submission to the Alabama Department of Environmental Management for the Kaskida oil pipeline, 2026
files.what_it_shows: Covers the companion Kaskida oil pipeline only (about 136 miles from the Kaskida platform in Keathley Canyon Block 293 to the Boxer platform in Green Canyon Block 19). It confirms the Kaskida platform location and says a separate gas export pipeline ties into the existing gas network. It has no map of the gas line.

searched: The Enbridge news release, which names the origin as the Kaskida development and the connection as the existing Magnolia Gas Gathering Pipeline, and has no route map.

The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management pipeline location shapefile (ppl_arcs.zip, updated Oct 14 2026): it holds Enbridge Offshore segments (30 active) but no proposed Canyon or Kaskida gas line, and its 24 proposed segments are unrelated.
Web searches for a BOEM or Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement right-of-way application for the gas line, which found only the oil line application.
FERC eLibrary text search for Canyon Gathering, with no relevant hit.
notes: No map of the gas line was found. Both ends are named in sources. The start is the Kaskida platform in Keathley Canyon Block 293 and the end is a subsea tie-in to Enbridge's existing Magnolia Gas Gathering Pipeline, reported in trade press to go through a new Sparta Gas Pipeline joint venture with Shell. The exact tie-in block is not stated. The sheet length of 60 miles is not confirmed by any source found. The Enbridge route for the oil line (136 miles) is a different system. The BOEM pipeline layer is vector data and should be rechecked later in case the gas line is added once its right-of-way is approved.
